parsed.reason: Strong on the first clause: it says "Not yet" right away and gives a reason from the ageGate (night feeds, body clock not settled) and the 6-month start. It gives no plan and no apology tour. However, it loses points for three things. It never says when it opens in a usable way relative to now; "starts at 6 months" is stated but not tied to his age (about two months away). It gives more than ONE thing: the room-sharing crib advice plus the "waking every 2 hours is common" reassurance. The crib-safety detail (firm, flat, nothing in it) is not in the ageGate, so it is partly unsupported, though sound. The reassurance about 2-hour wakings is also unsupported by the ageGate. Overall a good but not perfect response.
